title: Gordon vs JBU: tuition, size, location

sections.heading: How they differ
paragraphs: John Brown University (JBU) and Gordon College are both private nonprofit institutions, as indicated by their ownership codes reported by College Scorecard. JBU has a slightly larger undergraduate enrollment with 1,471 students compared to Gordon College's 1,278. Tuition costs for in-state students are similar, with JBU charging $31,756 and Gordon College $30,700. Geographically, the two schools are located in different cities, with JBU situated in Siloam Springs and Gordon College in Wenham. These distinctions highlight some of the key differences between JBU and Gordon.

sections.heading: Cost
paragraphs: When comparing John Brown University (JBU) vs Gordon College in terms of cost, both institutions have similar tuition rates for in-state and out-of-state students. JBU charges $31,756 for tuition regardless of residency status, while Gordon College's tuition is slightly lower at $30,700 for both in-state and out-of-state students. However, the median debt of students who complete their programs differs between the two schools. Graduates from JBU carry a median debt of $21,250, which is lower than the $26,250 median debt reported for Gordon College completers. These financial figures provide insight into the cost of attendance and student borrowing at each institution.
